title: JUNG AHYEON — The One Who Was Worth the Wait (Documentary)
description:
JUNG AHYEON — The One Who Was Worth the Wait

A 29-minute documentary on BABYMONSTER's Jung Ahyeon — the most-watched debut in K-pop history, the seven months of silence, and the records that followed. Every figure in this film is sourced.

CHAPTERS
00:08 COLD OPEN — The One Who Was Missing
01:22 ACT I — A Voice From Chuncheon
04:32 ACT II — Next Movement
08:02 ACT III — Dangerously
10:49 ACT IV — The Wait
14:26 ACT V — Sheesh
17:54 ACT VI — Monster Era
21:09 ACT VII — The It-Girl Year
26:14 OUTRO — The Dome
